{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are generally too high starting at day 3, showing early-stage mean reversion from cycle peaks",
    "Sentiment turning negative (below 0) correlates with model undershooting true prices, especially at cycle bottoms",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (above 0.67), model forecasts are too low, lagging behind true price momentum",
    "The gap between model and true prices increases through the first 10-15 days of the forecast horizon",
    "Model fails to capture the magnitude of price corrections at the beginning of sentiment reversals",
    "When prices are in a clear downtrend, model maintains too much upside bias in early forecast days",
    "Sentiment-based corrections in the model are slower and less extreme than actual price corrections"
] }
